card.name: Weekday names before dates
card.fires_on: Names of weekdays (Thursday, Friday, Wednesday, French samedi) in dates, event listings and schedules. Also the comma right after a weekday before the month and day.

modes.label: Weekday before a date
modes.description: A weekday name that starts a dated line, often followed by month, day and year.

modes.label: Weekday in a schedule phrase
modes.description: A weekday used for when something happens, such as 'on the evening of' or 'every'.
modes.example: Games happening every<< Tuesday>> and Thursday evening at Hana Ball Park

modes.label: Comma after weekday
modes.description: The comma following a weekday name, just before the month.

card.plain: It lights up on weekday names in dates and schedules, such as Thursday, 21 August.
